messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"verse":11,"text":"And when they had learned this, they went out of the city with the inhabitants, and my fellow-citizens pointed me out to them."},{"chapter":7,"verse":12,"text":"But these remonstrated and said: \"Surely, this is not Jobab."},{"chapter":7,"verse":13,"text":"And while they hesitated, there said Eliphaz. the King of Teman: \"Come let us step near and see.\""},{"chapter":7,"verse":14,"text":"And when they came near I remembered them, and I wept very much when I learned the purpose of their journey."},{"chapter":7,"verse":15,"text":"And I threw earth upon my head, and while shaking my head I revealed unto them that I was [Job]."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
